comparisons.peer_summary: The total fair value of PRSUs vested was $226 million in 2024, $100 million in 2023, and $254 million in 2022, with $154 million of unrecognized compensation expense remaining as of December 28, 2024, to be recognized over a weighted-average period of 1.61 years.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclose financial details regarding the vesting of performance-based restricted stock units (PRSUs) and the associated unrecognized compensation expense. NVDA reports that property, equipment, and intangible assets acquired by assuming liabilities were $170 million in 2024, while AMD discloses that the total fair value of PRSUs vested was $226 million in 2024, with $154 million of unrecognized compensation expense remaining. Both disclosures provide a breakdown of current year activity versus prior years (2023, 2022) for these specific non-cash compensation and acquisition metrics.

sentences.text: Property, equipment and intangible assets acquired by assuming related liabilities during fiscal years 2024, 2023, and 2022 were $170 million, $374 million, and $258 million, respectively.
The total fair value of PRSUs vested during 2024, 2023 and 2022 was $226 million, $100 million and $254 million, respectively.
As of December 28, 2024, the Company had $154 million of total unrecognized compensation expense related to PRSUs, which will be recognized over the weighted-average period of 1.61 years.
